import re
WORK = re.compile(r"^(?P<key>WORK)=(?P<value>\S+)$")
CMD = re.compile(r"^(?P<env>(?:\w+=\S*\s+)*?)(?P<command>\S+)(?: (?P<args>.*?))?(?: # (?P<note>\S.*))?$")
HEREDOC = re.compile(r"^cat >(?P<file>\S+) << '(?P<tag>\w+)'")
CD = re.compile(r"^cd (?P<dir>\S+)$")
CFG = re.compile(r"^(?P<directive>\w+) (?P<rest>.*)$")
KV = re.compile(r"^(?P<key>\S+?)=(?P<value>.*)$")


def parse(lines):
    work, cmds, cfg = {}, [], []
    wl, cl, fl, skip = [], [], [], []
    cwd = ""
    heredoc = None
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        if heredoc is not None:
            if ln == heredoc[1]:
                cl.append(i)
                heredoc = None
            elif ln.startswith("#"):
                skip.append(i)
            else:
                m = CFG.match(ln)
                d = m.group("directive") if m else ""
                rest = m.group("rest") if m else ln
                kv = KV.match(rest)
                cfg.append({"file": heredoc[0], "directive": d, "key": kv.group("key") if kv else "",
                            "value": kv.group("value") if kv else rest})
                fl.append(i)
            continue
        m = WORK.match(ln)
        if m:
            work[m.group("key")] = m.group("value")
            wl.append(i)
            continue
        m = CMD.match(ln)
        if not m:
            continue
        cmds.append({"cwd": cwd, "env": m.group("env").strip(), "command": m.group("command"),
                     "args": m.group("args") or "", "note": m.group("note") or ""})
        cl.append(i)
        h = HEREDOC.match(ln)
        if h:
            heredoc = (h.group("file"), h.group("tag"))
        c = CD.match(ln)
        if c:
            cwd = c.group("dir")
    blocks = [
        {"name": "work", "kind": "kv", "lines": wl, "records": [work]},
        {"name": "commands", "kind": "table", "lines": cl, "records": cmds},
        {"name": "importcfg", "kind": "table", "lines": fl, "records": cfg},
    ]
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": skip}
